versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1

- Added a new introduction section for clarity on skill capabilities, setup, and data flow
- Provided a structured overview table outlining the guide's organization and reference links
- Clarified the relationship to the original community use case (Telegram, VPS are now described as examples, not requirements)
- Included a new Mermaid diagram showing agent, team, and customer/task structure
- Updated quick start instructions and links to setup/reference documents
- No functional changes; documentation and onboarding focused update

- Initial release of the dev_team skill for orchestrating multi-agent teams in OpenClaw.
- Provides guided onboarding for first-time setup, including detailed references and role templates.
- Supports specialized agent workflows (PM, dev, QA, security) with shared memory and control channels.
- Includes workflow patterns for solo-founder and agency/multi-customer setups.
- Source and usage examples based on the awesome-openclaw-usecases multi-agent team scenario.
